dishes_routing_required.name: dishes_routing_required
dishes_routing_required.value: "dishes"."kind" = 'set' OR ("dishes"."station_grill" IS NOT NULL AND "dishes"."station_no_grill" IS NOT NULL)

dishes_sale_range_check.name: dishes_sale_range_check
dishes_sale_range_check.value: "dishes"."sale_from" IS NULL OR "dishes"."sale_to" IS NULL OR "dishes"."sale_to" >= "dishes"."sale_from"

dishes_sale_window_check.name: dishes_sale_window_check
dishes_sale_window_check.value:
("dishes"."sale_start_minute" IS NULL) = ("dishes"."sale_end_minute" IS NULL)
       AND ("dishes"."sale_start_minute" IS NULL
            OR ("dishes"."sale_start_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "dishes"."sale_end_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440
                AND "dishes"."sale_end_minute" > "dishes"."sale_start_minute"))

invoices_issued_check.name: invoices_issued_check
invoices_issued_check.value:
"invoices"."state" <> 'issued'
       OR ("invoices"."invoice_no" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."tax_code" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."issued_at" IS NOT NULL)

invoices_void_check.name: invoices_void_check
invoices_void_check.value: "invoices"."state" <> 'voided' OR ("invoices"."void_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "invoices"."approval_id" IS NOT NULL)

leave_requests_counterpart_check.name: leave_requests_counterpart_check
leave_requests_counterpart_check.value:
("leave_requests"."kind" = 'doi-ca' AND "leave_requests"."counterpart_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("leave_requests"."kind" <> 'doi-ca' AND "leave_requests"."counterpart_id" IS NULL)

leave_requests_decided_check.name: leave_requests_decided_check
leave_requests_decided_check.value: "leave_requests"."state" = 'pending' OR ("leave_requests"."decided_by" IS NOT NULL AND "leave_requests"."decided_at" IS NOT NULL)

payroll_lines_nonneg.name: payroll_lines_nonneg
payroll_lines_nonneg.value:
"payroll_lines"."base_pay_vnd" >= 0 AND "payroll_lines"."overtime_pay_vnd" >= 0 AND "payroll_lines"."allowance_vnd" >= 0
      AND "payroll_lines"."bonus_vnd" >= 0 AND "payroll_lines"."insurance_vnd" >= 0 AND "payroll_lines"."tax_vnd" >= 0
      AND "payroll_lines"."advance_vnd" >= 0

payroll_periods_order_check.name: payroll_periods_order_check
payroll_periods_order_check.value:
("payroll_periods"."state" = 'draft')
       OR ("payroll_periods"."state" = 'locked'    AND "payroll_periods"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("payroll_periods"."state" = 'submitted' AND "payroll_periods"."locked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_periods"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("payroll_periods"."state" = 'checked'   AND "payroll_periods"."submitted_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_periods"."checked_at" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("payroll_periods"."state" = 'approved'  AND "payroll_periods"."checked_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_periods"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("payroll_periods"."state" = 'paid'      AND "payroll_periods"."approved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "payroll_periods"."paid_at" IS NOT NULL)

schedule_entries_published_at_check.name: schedule_entries_published_at_check
schedule_entries_published_at_check.value:
("schedule_entries"."state" = 'draft' AND "schedule_entries"."published_at" IS NULL)
       OR ("schedule_entries"."state" = 'published' AND "schedule_entries"."published_at" IS NOT NULL)

expense_entries_source_link.name: expense_entries_source_link
expense_entries_source_link.value:
("expense_entries"."source" = 'voucher' AND "expense_entries"."voucher_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("expense_entries"."source" = 'depreciation' AND "expense_entries"."asset_id" IS NOT NULL)

production_lines_share_check.name: production_lines_share_check
production_lines_share_check.value:
("production_lines"."direction" = 'out' AND "production_lines"."cost_share_bp" BETWEEN 0 AND 10000)
       OR ("production_lines"."direction" = 'in' AND "production_lines"."cost_share_bp" IS NULL)

stock_moves_sign_check.name: stock_moves_sign_check
stock_moves_sign_check.value:
("stock_moves"."kind" IN ('receipt','transfer_in','produce_in') AND "stock_moves"."qty_base" > 0)
       OR ("stock_moves"."kind" IN ('sale','write_off','internal','transfer_out','produce_out') AND "stock_moves"."qty_base" < 0)
       OR ("stock_moves"."kind" = 'count_adjust' AND "stock_moves"."qty_base" <> 0)

stock_moves_reason_required.name: stock_moves_reason_required
stock_moves_reason_required.value: "stock_moves"."kind" NOT IN ('count_adjust','write_off','internal') OR "stock_moves"."note" IS NOT NULL

order_batches_fired_at_check.name: order_batches_fired_at_check
order_batches_fired_at_check.value: ("order_batches"."state" = 'held' AND "order_batches"."fired_at" IS NULL) OR ("order_batches"."state" = 'fired' AND "order_batches"."fired_at" IS NOT NULL)

tickets_clock_check.name: tickets_clock_check
tickets_clock_check.value: ("tickets"."state" = 'waiting' AND "tickets"."queued_at" IS NULL) OR ("tickets"."state" <> 'waiting' AND "tickets"."queued_at" IS NOT NULL)

payments_target_required.name: payments_target_required
payments_target_required.value: "payments"."order_id" IS NOT NULL OR "payments"."table_session_id" IS NOT NULL

printers_station_check.name: printers_station_check
printers_station_check.value:
("printers"."kind" = 'tem' AND "printers"."station_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("printers"."kind" = 'bill' AND "printers"."station_id" IS NULL)

feedback_resolved_check.name: feedback_resolved_check
feedback_resolved_check.value:
"feedback"."state" <> 'resolved'
       OR ("feedback"."resolution" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback"."resolved_at" IS NOT NULL AND "feedback"."resolved_by" IS NOT NULL)

loyalty_entries_shape_check.name: loyalty_entries_shape_check
loyalty_entries_shape_check.value:
("loyalty_entries"."kind" = 'earn'    AND "loyalty_entries"."points" > 0 AND "loyalty_entries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("loyalty_entries"."kind" = 'redeem'  AND "loyalty_entries"."points" < 0 AND "loyalty_entries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("loyalty_entries"."kind" = 'reclaim' AND "loyalty_entries"."points" < 0 AND "loyalty_entries"."order_id" IS NOT NULL)
       OR ("loyalty_entries"."kind" = 'expire'  AND "loyalty_entries"."points" < 0)
       OR ("loyalty_entries"."kind" = 'adjust'  AND "loyalty_entries"."reason" IS NOT NULL AND "loyalty_entries"."staff_id" IS NOT NULL)

promotions_value_check.name: promotions_value_check
promotions_value_check.value:
("promotions"."kind" = 'percent'   AND "promotions"."percent_bp" BETWEEN 1 AND 10000
                                   AND "promotions"."amount_vnd" IS NULL AND "promotions"."set_price_vnd" IS NULL)
       OR ("promotions"."kind" = 'amount'    AND "promotions"."amount_vnd" > 0
                                   AND "promotions"."percent_bp" IS NULL AND "promotions"."set_price_vnd" IS NULL)
       OR ("promotions"."kind" = 'free_dish' AND "promotions"."target_dish_id" IS NOT NULL
                                   AND "promotions"."percent_bp" IS NULL AND "promotions"."amount_vnd" IS NULL
                                   AND "promotions"."set_price_vnd" IS NULL)
       OR ("promotions"."kind" = 'set_price' AND "promotions"."target_dish_id" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."set_price_vnd" >= 0
                                   AND "promotions"."percent_bp" IS NULL AND "promotions"."amount_vnd" IS NULL)

promotions_hour_check.name: promotions_hour_check
promotions_hour_check.value:
("promotions"."from_minute" IS NULL AND "promotions"."to_minute" IS NULL)
       OR ("promotions"."from_minute" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "promotions"."to_minute" BETWEEN 1 AND 1440
           AND "promotions"."to_minute" > "promotions"."from_minute")

promotions_activated_check.name: promotions_activated_check
promotions_activated_check.value: "promotions"."state" <> 'active' OR ("promotions"."activated_at" IS NOT NULL AND "promotions"."activated_by" IS NOT NULL)
